name: smwgraphics-acme-animation-factory-intro-screen-font
title: ACME Animation Factory - intro screen font
description:
The font used during the intro screen of 'ACME Animation Factory', a Mario Paint-Like SNES Game.
Letters have 3 colors in the original game, but they were arranged to use only 2 colors.

It includes a GFX2A file. I added new characters such as 8, 9, a double quote (replace an unused tile), and also 'ILLUSI' and 'YELLOW' if you use these. Yoshi's footprint is also changed to match.
